results.content: US President Donald Trump’s job approval rating has hit 34%, tied for a record low across both his presidential terms in the July 25–27 Economist/YouGov poll. The survey found that 62% disapproved of his job performance, putting his net approval at -28. Support has weakened among Independents, Gen X and white Americans, according to YouGov. The numbers highlight growing dissatisfaction with Trump’s presidency as his administration faces scrutiny over its policies and performance.

Methodology

Each week, YouGov invites around 1,500 members of its opt-in panel to complete an online questionnaire. The respondents are selected to be representative of American adult citizens and the data is weighted to represent the country according to gender, age, race, education and voting behaviour. To track the results of YouGov’s polling over time, The Economist aggregates survey data each week and fits a line of best fit.
